relationships.subject: activity-based interventions
relationships.evidence_quote: Multiple activity-based paradigms worked through inflammatory signaling reduction, restoration of local inhibitory mechanisms of dorsal horn neurons, and modulation of maladaptive plasticity in the spinal cord gray matter circuitry.

relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Previous research demonstrated a dramatically increased expression of TNFα and IL1β at- and below-level 12–15 weeks post-SCI, which was associated with the development of below-level thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: dorsal horn microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: increased activation of Iba1-expressing microglial cells in the dorsal horn below the level of SCI is associated with the development and maintenance of below-level allodynia after SCI

relationships.subject: DRG macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating a role for DRG macrophage induction in mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: dorsal horn microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: In the early stages of SCI, neurotrophic factors such as NGF, BDNF, and GDNF are released from activated microglia and are elevated following injury

key_findings: Review of 19 rodent studies: weight-bearing rhythmic activity-based interventions attenuate SCI-induced neuropathic pain whether started early or delayed, but effects may not persist after cessation.
ABI act through reduced inflammatory signalling, restored dorsal horn inhibition and modulation of maladaptive spinal plasticity.
